text.p: These are leading stories in this morning's Paris newspapers.
-- Carmaker Volvo sells 11.38 percent stake in Renault for around 4.6 billion francs.
-- French government presented bailout plan for state bank Credit Lyonnais to European Commission yesterday.
-- Unemployment rose 0.6 percent in June to a record 12.6 percent, government considering shorter work hours to fight joblessness.
-- Vendome Luxury Group Plc buys French leather goods firm Lancel for some 1.36 billion francs.
-- European Monetary Institute considers establishing European call money rate.
-- Number of jobseekers rose by 17,400 in June to 3,130,900.
-- Paris bourse soars to new records.
-- Government asks European Commission to approve further aid for Credit Lyonnais without committing itself to a privatisation.
-- Eramet shareholders approve new board and resolutions to protect minority shareholders, confirm chairman Yves Rambaud.
-- Data show U.S. economy cooling to comfortable pace.
